visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a light blue t-shirt and black shorts stands in an indoor room that resembles a home office. He points toward a white floor fan positioned to his left on a tiled floor. Behind him, there are multiple desks with computer monitors, office chairs, and shelves filled with trophies. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The man leans down to touch the fan, and it immediately begins to slide across the smooth floor as if propelled by its own motor. He looks into the camera with a surprised and amused expression, gesturing with his hands. Yellow and white captions appear on the screen. (3) The man reaches down and tilts the fan over to expose the underside of its circular base. Attached to the bottom are several small, black swivel caster wheels. He smiles broadly while holding the fan tilted. (4) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a brown ribbed t-shirt and khaki shorts, enters the frame. She stands next to the fan, gesturing animatedly with her hands as she explains something. The camera moves slightly to follow her movements. (5) The woman demonstrates the fan's mobility by pushing it with one hand; it glides effortlessly across the tiled surface. The man stands nearby, watching and reacting with laughter. (6) Close-up shots show the fan base being moved and the wheels spinning. The woman continues to speak directly to the camera, touching her hair and using wide hand gestures to emphasize her points. The background remains the office setting with visible trophies and desks.

(4) [Subtitle]: 你知道為什麼嗎?. (5) [Subtitle]: 有一個天才她給我在電風扇下面裝了一堆輪子.... [Variety]: 就是我~!. (6) [Subtitle]: 真的傻眼. [Variety]: (自由自在). (7) [Subtitle]: 自從上次的馬桶跟各種... 這個真的是很莫名其妙. [Slogan]: 發明了一個『會跑的電風扇』. (18) [Subtitle]: 所以我就說我擔心同事啊. [Variety]: (承認吧你就是同事本人). (19) [Subtitle]: 那我必須承認我後來貼五顆之後它跑到我自己也會抓狂. (20) [Subtitle]: 那我問你這三顆輪子設計的算OK嗎?. [Subtitle]: 我會直接選擇把它抬起來. [Subtitle]: 可以啦三顆可以! 你看他這樣推來推去奪OK啊! 好棒好棒...
